title: Slot fragmentation runway and burst simulator (weekly export)
content:
Purpose:
Estimate cluster/pool "runway" (days until capacity breach) under realistic burst patterns while accounting for slot fragmentation and reservation leakage. This sheet is a compact weekly export from the simulator run for regional pools (NA-EAST, NA-WEST, EU-CENTRAL, AP-SEA). Intended for planning conversations with SRE and capacity procurement.

Assumptions and definitions:
- Slot: minimal allocatable unit (e.g., 1 GPU indexed slice).
- Fragmentation Index (FI): percent of fleet GPU-slices unusable for new reservations due to insulation of small idle pieces (0-1). Higher FI => less effective spare capacity.
- Reservation Leakage: fraction of reserved slots not returned on time due to stuck jobs / slow teardown.
- Burst Profile: probabilistic distribution of short-term demand spikes (1h-6h) measured from last 90 days; model uses a 95th percentile spike multiplier for conservative runway estimate.
- Headroom Target: desired spare capacity (in slots) to satisfy latency SLOs during 99th percentile spikes.

Summary (topline):
- Simulator run date: 2026-03-09T04:20Z
- Pools simulated: NA-EAST, NA-WEST, EU-CENTRAL, AP-SEA
- Baseline fleet slots: NA-EAST 12,880 | NA-WEST 6,120 | EU-CENTRAL 9,400 | AP-SEA 3,200
- Observed FI (current telemetry avg): NA-EAST 0.14 | NA-WEST 0.18 | EU-CENTRAL 0.09 | AP-SEA 0.22
- Reservation leakage (30-day avg): NA-EAST 0.012 | NA-WEST 0.017 | EU-CENTRAL 0.006 | AP-SEA 0.021

How Effective_Free is computed (explained in the sheet):
- Effective_Free = floor(Free_Slots * (1 - Fragmentation_Index) - (Total_Slots * Reservation_Leakage))
- Runway_days_steady = Effective_Free / average_daily_consumption (7-day trailing mean)
- Runway_days_burst95 = Effective_Free / (burst95_incremental_daily_equivalent)

Simulation parameters used for this export:
- average_daily_consumption (derived from /telemetry/consumption-7d): NA-EAST 32, NA-WEST 39, EU-CENTRAL 13, AP-SEA 76 (slots/day equivalent)
- burst95_multiplier: 6x for NA pools, 8x for AP-SEA, 5x for EU-CENTRAL
- reserve_shock: scheduled on-call rebalancing windows (0.6% capacity withheld during midnight UTC maintenance)

Scenario snapshots included in the sheet (columns show resulting runway_days_burst95):
1) Baseline telemetry -> values as top table.
2) +10% short-term demand (next 14d sustained) -> NA-EAST 28, NA-WEST 18, EU-CENTRAL 52, AP-SEA 7
3) Fragmentation improvement -0.04 absolute (e.g., reclaiming small slices via packing) -> NA-EAST 46, NA-WEST 31, EU-CENTRAL 76, AP-SEA 12
4) Reservation leakage spike +0.01 absolute (stuck jobs during rollout) -> NA-EAST 21, NA-WEST 13, EU-CENTRAL 46, AP-SEA 4
5) Emergency diurnal burst (24h 12x multiplier) with current FI -> immediate shortfall projected in AP-SEA and NA-WEST; NA-EAST gives ~6h buffer before fallback.

Immediate action items called out (for next 7 days):
- SRE: enable aggressive packing experiment on NA-WEST during maintenance window (ENGINF-PR-598) to target FI -0.05; monitor pre/post job tail latency.
- Scheduling: add a pre-empt check in job-teardown to reduce leakage by 30% for small jobs (ticket: JIRA-ENGINF-1432).
- Capacity: evaluate a micro-bump order of 600 slots to NA-WEST if simulator shows runway <21d after packing attempt.
- Product: notify two high-commit customers for potential rate-limiter during planned rebalances (template in linked confluence).

Open questions / notes to follow up:
- Are packing gains sustainable under multi-tenant fairness constraints? (SLO risk: cold-start latency for small batches)
- Can we run a midnight-only packing window for AP-SEA to avoid product impact?
- Validate job telemetry for small slices: there is a ~6% mismatch between sampler and aggregator for <0.05 slice buckets.

- Exporter script: infra/tools/capacity/simulate_runway.py (invoked with --lookback 90 --burst percentile 95)
- Last simulator commit: github PR 598; main change: incorporate reservation aging curve into leakage projection.

Sheet generation note: automated weekly job; this export was trimmed to include only pools with runway_burst95 < 60 days plus a representative healthy pool for comparison.
